params.name: chain
params.description: The chain to query

params.name: from_block
params.description:
The minimum block number from which to get the transactions
* Provide the param 'from_block' or 'from_date'
* If 'from_date' and 'from_block' are provided, 'from_block' will be used.

params.name: to_block
params.description:
The maximum block number from which to get the transactions.
* Provide the param 'to_block' or 'to_date'
* If 'to_date' and 'to_block' are provided, 'to_block' will be used.

params.name: from_date
params.description:
The start date from which to get the transactions (format in seconds or datestring accepted by momentjs)
* Provide the param 'from_block' or 'from_date'
* If 'from_date' and 'from_block' are provided, 'from_block' will be used.

params.name: to_date
params.description:
Get the transactions up to this date (format in seconds or datestring accepted by momentjs)
* Provide the param 'to_block' or 'to_date'
* If 'to_date' and 'to_block' are provided, 'to_block' will be used.

params.name: address
params.description: The address of the wallet

params.name: cursor
params.description: The cursor returned in the previous response (used for getting the next page).

params.name: order
params.description: The order of the result, in ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC)

params.name: limit
params.description: The desired page size of the result.

params.name: include
params.description: If the result should contain the internal transactions.
